primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

reviewed_content: All 12 current formal pages were read and verified against the fixed 105-file scope; all scope hashes matched exactly.

The main page requires a held, same-item hit classified as a weakspot; a body hit is excluded only when it is not classified as a weakspot. The blessing clears current suppression and grants suppression immunity for a single refreshed I–IV window of 2.4, 2.8, 3.2, or 3.6 seconds.

The first qualifying event resolves before the subsequent keyword-cache update; refresh resets the one window, switching off disables the held-gated effect after cache update, and switching back before expiry can restore it after cache update.
Galvanic Rifle Mk CV action_bash is a Sweep and remains a melee attack even though its profile has is_push=true; eligibility still depends on actual weakspot classification and on_hit delivery.
Heavy Laspistol pure PushAttack uses torso hit-zone input and ordinarily is not a weakspot event; the documented external guaranteed-weakspot override remains an exception.

Needle Pistol direct hitscan, center-mass AoE with source item, and toxin interval ticks are distinguished. Toxin ticks use attack_type=buff without a hit zone; external guaranteed-weakspot effects can override the weakspot result, while this blessing itself does not grant that keyword.
Both worked examples use bound UI models and event-processing times: Autogun Mk III tier IV expires at t<13.6; Galvanic Rifle Mk CV tier I refreshes at t=22.0 and then expires at t<24.4.
Tier table, paired English/Traditional Chinese RAW strings, formatter reconstruction, all 14 bound model names, six trait implementations, and icon weapon_trait_122 image receipt were checked.
